items.title: Perez gets a five-place Qatar drop after the Vegas clash
items.summary: Stewards' Document 61 found Perez wholly responsible for the Turn 14 collision with Rafael Câmara and converted his unserved 10-second penalty into five places at his next race. In a later Formula1.com report, Perez said he thought he was alongside; Câmara said he still needed to review what happened.
items.why_it_matters: Apply the five places in Qatar grid preparation. Keep the drivers' accounts separate from the stewards' finding and do not copy Vegas power-unit penalties or energy limits into Qatar event data.

sources.label: Formula1.com report and driver reactions, full article checked

items.title: Qatar's 27-lap cap makes two stops the minimum
items.summary: Pirelli F1 chief engineer Simone Berra told Motorsport.com that each Qatar set is limited to 27 laps, two more than in 2025; laps are counted by session, race laps behind the Safety Car count, and remaining per-set allowances follow Saturday running. Coffee Corner Motorsport's 24 November preview says all event running counts against each set and reports a 26.5-second average pit-loss estimate. On the scheduled 57-lap distance, the cap requires at least three sets and two stops. Pirelli's official 13 November release confirms the C1/C2/C3 compound selection, not the event prescription.
items.why_it_matters: Practice and qualifying consume each set's 27-lap allowance, constraining race flexibility. The 26.5-second pit-loss figure is Coffee Corner's published strategy estimate, not an FIA-issued prescription; the official Qatar FIA event document remains unverified while its listing is unavailable.

sources.label: Motorsport.com report and Berra interview, 20 November

items.title: Haas confirms Rafael Câmara for Qatar and Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Haas confirmed that Câmara will drive for the team at both remaining 2026 Grands Prix after his starts in Brazil and Las Vegas, ahead of his full-time Haas campaign in 2027.
items.why_it_matters: Câmara's Qatar participation is confirmed, but the article is not a complete event entry list or a confirmation of any FP1 substitutions.
